name: A Thousand "No" and One "Yes"
overview: One chance encounter forever changes the lives of Oksana, a young girl from a simple family, and Sergei, a young oligarch. It all starts with the wedding. Oksana's sister Tanya is getting married. The wedding day turns into a series of disasters — literally everything is not going according to plan. Tanya's ex-lover even appears at the wedding. And the self-confident rich man Sergei makes an offer to Oksana in front of everyone. Oksana's refusal really hurts Sergey.: "And even if you say no a thousand times, sooner or later you'll say yes anyway!"
